此时已经没有人拍摄了，所以一些工作人员也在用餐，看到从酒店门口进来的男人，一些年轻的小姑娘，低呼了起来。

“阿墨。”夏萱听到声音回头看去，脸上立即扬起惊喜娇媚的笑，她起身迎了过去，“你怎么来了？”

“在这里谈事，听说你在这里，顺便看看你。”席墨不冷不淡的应了一声，余光却落到了时笙身上。

那个他记忆中有些怯懦，胆小的女孩子，此时已经完全变了样。

没有华丽的衣服，没有精致的妆容，没有昂贵的首饰。她一身普通的运动服，安静的坐在那方，一股贵气却油然而生。

但是那股贵气中，似乎又掺杂了一些痞气……

时笙看到席墨有些膈应，起身准备离开，但是从她这里出去，就必须路过两人，衡量了下，时笙又坐了回去。

席墨眸光沉了沉，和夏萱说了几句话，就离开了。

夏萱回到时笙桌子边，压低了声音道：“江晚，我一定会让你滚出娱乐圈。”

“真巧，我的目标和你一样。”时笙往后仰了仰，“我们就看看，谁先让谁滚出娱乐圈，如何？”

夏萱轻蔑的嗤笑一声，“让我滚出娱乐圈？江晚，你真以为和夏满弄出一个破公司，就能和我比了？你现在也不过是个三线明星，连一线都还没到，你有什么能力让我滚出娱乐圈？”

时笙撑着下巴，笑着道：“可是我现在是有后台的人啊！”

本宝宝现在可是有有间娱乐做靠山。

有间娱乐在京城，也是有地位的，不像东方娱乐。

听闻最近东方娱乐在往京城发展，席墨此时出现在这里，恐怕就是为了这件事吧。

“后台？”夏萱皱了下眉，旋即又松开，眼底满是嫌恶，“呵，江晚，你觉得那些男人，会为了一个明星，和一个影后和两个家族做对？”

她一个三线小明星，靠身体能找到多大的靠山。

“会不会，试试不就知道了？”

“这是你自找的。”

“今天的任务已经发到你们手机上，现在进行分组，两人一组，抽中同一个颜色的为一组。”导演扯着喉咙吼了一嗓子。

工作人员拿着密封的盒子挨个走过来。

时笙和方立秋站在一块，方立秋抽中了蓝色，而时笙却抽中了绿色。

“啊，不是一组啊！”方立秋立即垮了脸，“小丸子，我们为什么不是一组啊！！”

跟着小丸子有肉吃有汤喝，幸福得不要不要的，可是现在竟然不在一组，呜呜，好伤心。

There was no one filming at this time, so some staff members were also dining. When they saw the men and some young girls coming in from the hotel door, they shouted.

"Ah Mo." Xia Xuan looked back when she heard the voice, a surprised and charming smile immediately appeared on her face. She stood up and greeted her, "Why are you here?"

"We are talking here. I heard you are here, so I stopped by to see you." Xi Mo responded calmly, but his peripheral vision fell on Shi Sheng.

The timid girl in his memory had completely changed.

No fancy clothes, no elaborate makeup, no expensive jewelry.She was wearing ordinary sportswear, sitting there quietly, but a sense of nobility arose spontaneously.

But that noble spirit seems to be mixed with some ruffianism...

Shi Sheng saw that Xi Mo was a little uncomfortable and stood up to leave. However, when leaving her place, he had to pass by the two of them. After weighing it, Shi Sheng sat back down.

Xi Mo's eyes darkened, he said a few words to Xia Xuan and then left.

Xia Xuan returned to Shi Sheng's table and lowered her voice: "Jiang Wan, I will definitely let you get out of the entertainment industry."

"What a coincidence, my goal is the same as yours." Shi Sheng leaned back, "Let's see who gets out of the entertainment industry first, how about that?"

Xia Xuan sneered contemptuously, "You want me to get out of the entertainment industry? Jiang Wan, do you really think you can compete with me by starting a bad company with Xia Man? You are only a third-tier star now, and you haven't even reached the first-tier. What ability do you have to get me out of the entertainment industry?"

Shi Sheng held up his chin and said with a smile, "But I have a backing now!"

This baby now has an entertainment backing.

There is an entertainment company in the capital that has status, unlike Oriental Entertainment.

I heard that Oriental Entertainment was developing in the capital recently. Xi Mo appeared here at this time, probably just for this matter.

"Backstage?" Xia Xuan frowned, then relaxed, her eyes full of disgust, "Oh, Jiang Wan, do you think those men would go against a movie queen and two families for a star?"

She is a third-tier starlet, but she can rely on her body to find as many supporters as possible.

"Is it possible? You'll know if you try it?"

"You asked for it."

"Today's task has been sent to your mobile phones. Now we will group you into two groups. Those who draw the same color will form a group." The director roared at the top of his throat.

The staff came one by one with sealed boxes.

Shi Sheng and Fang Liqiu stood together. Fang Liqiu drew blue, but Shi Sheng drew green.

"Ah, we're not a group!" Fang Liqiu's face immediately collapsed, "Xiaowanzi, why are we not a group!!"

Following Xiao Wanzi, we had meat to eat and soup to drink. We were so happy, but now we are not in the same group. Ouch, so sad.
